acceptanceRuleStatus: Recommendations for this review, not a new product release policy.
limits: No full-image precision/recall: unannotated outputs and objects are not exhaustively scored.
No measured correction seconds/clicks, user study or scan/multiple-frame performance.
A saved candidate preserves model output; it does not establish visual correctness.
Partial correspondence counts describe the existing tested objects only; approximate geometry and human interpretation remain uncertain.
Four reference-error cases and four uncertain cases must not be counted as definite model mistakes.
